name: dynamic-item-info
author: DaggerHashimoto
description: Turns the item information window into clear sections: live stats, refine values now and at the next level, a labelled comparison with what you have equipped, the copies you carry and their restrictions, effects, random options, cards you can expand, and whether your level meets the requirements. Works on any item the game shows you, and keeps the game's own art, buttons and full description. The Inventory, Equipment, Status, Skill Tree, Party, Guild, Basic Info, the chat box, the skill bar and the Escape and settings menus get the same look, with search, sort, a list view, a weight bar and a light or midnight theme; the chat box is also resizable in width and stays translucent over gameplay. Every other game window gets the matching title bar and frame. Renewal and pre-renewal.

settings.label: New Inventory window
settings.description: Turn off to keep the game's own Inventory.

settings.label: New Equipment and Status windows
settings.description: Turn off to keep the game's own Equipment (Alt+Q) and Status windows.

settings.label: New Skill Tree window
settings.description: Turn off to keep the game's own Skill Tree (Alt+S).

settings.label: New Basic Info window
settings.description: Your job badge with your level, big HP and SP bars with numbers, exp bars, weight and zeny chips, and the menu on rounded tiles. Turn off to keep the game's own.

settings.label: New Party, Guild and other windows
settings.description: Party and Guild in the new look, and the blue title bar and rounded frame on every other game window. Turn off to keep the game's own.

settings.label: New chat box
settings.description: Translucent glass, gold sender names, and a corner grip to resize its width. Turn off to keep the game's own.

settings.label: Chat box background (%)
settings.description: How solid the chat box background is. Lower keeps more of the game showing through behind it. In light it never goes below a readable cream; at midnight, never below a readable navy.

settings.label: New skill bar
settings.description: Larger tiles with each slot's hotkey under it, and Rows buttons to show 1 to 4 rows. Drag-drop, hotkeys and cooldowns are the game's own. Turn off to keep the game's own bar.

settings.label: Start in the midnight theme
settings.description: The moon and sun button in the Inventory switches the theme of every window any time and remembers your choice.
